name: apple-mail-mcp
description: Search and read Apple Mail on macOS, read-only: mailboxes, messages and threads.
long_description: A read-only MCP server for Apple Mail. A notarized helper app reads Mail's local index and message files; it is the only process that needs Full Disk Access. Accounts, junk, trash and security mails are controlled by the settings below, never by the assistant.

tools.name: list_mailboxes
tools.description: Lists the visible mail accounts and mailboxes with message counts.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Searches messages by sender, recipient, subject, date, mailbox and body text.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Returns one message with headers, attachment names and body text.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Returns summaries of the messages in a conversation.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Accounts to include, by address, name or UUID. Empty means all accounts.

include_junk.title: Include junk
include_junk.description: Include mailboxes with the junk role.

include_trash.title: Include trash
include_trash.description: Include mailboxes with the trash role.

exclude_mailboxes.title: Excluded mailboxes
exclude_mailboxes.description: Comma-separated mailboxes to hide, by name or by path with /.

show_security_mails.title: Show security mails
show_security_mails.description: Show sign-in codes and password reset mails unfiltered.

max_results.title: Maximum results
max_results.description: Upper bound for the number of results of a search (1 to 100).

max_body_chars.title: Maximum body length
max_body_chars.description: Upper bound for the characters of a message body (1000 to 100000).
